summary.text: Nan Polk is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 54 in the November 3, 2026 general election; she was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2022.
A retired teacher and former school board member, she describes rural healthcare, public education and rural broadband as priorities.

paragraphs.text: Nan Polk's career experience includes working as an educator and administrator, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong resident of New Castle who graduated from Butler University, earned a master's degree at Ball State, and retired after 32 years of teaching high school science.
She said she then taught parenting at a childcare facility for high school parents, helped open four affordable childcare programs, and served nine years on the New Castle school board.
Polk was the Democratic candidate for Indiana House District 54 in the November 8, 2022 general election, which Cory Criswell won with 73.7% of the vote to her 26.3%.
In her 2026 survey, Polk said she is a retired teacher who served several years on the school board, and named public education as a policy area she is passionate about.
Her campaign themes of faith, family and future include protecting rural healthcare access, expanding rural broadband, reducing property-tax burdens and supporting family farms.
